text.p: Following are the main stories in Tuesday morning newspapers:
- The government proposed a national gross minimum monthly salary of 59,150 tolars ($377.3).
- Slovenian and Croatian economy ministers met to discuss nuclear power plant Krsko, the only one in the region. They said only about 20 percent of problems between the two states remained unsolved.

- German Minister for Post and Telecommunications Wolfgang Boesch met Slovenian Transport Minister Anton Bergauer to discuss telecommunications development in Slovenia and cooperation between the two states.
- A large delegation from Brazil's most prosperous state Minas Gerais on Monday visited Slovenia and signed agreement on cooperation between the two economies.
- The environment ministry said it would put 40 million tolars each year into waste water purifaction in Slovenia's second city Maribor.
- Interior Minister Mirko Bandelj said Slovenia will reform its administration in line with EU standards, raising efficiency without increasing the number of employed.
